title: Best way to move Xdrip plus master to new phone
symptom: The user has xDrip+ setup with a master and follower, where the master is on the wife's phone. She got a new phone and they need to move the master setup to the new phone.
fix: Install a fresh xdrip on the new phone and on the existing master use the 3 dot menu on the top right and select to share the settings via QR code and then select the all settings option. When the QR code shows use the new phone and in settings select Auto configure from barcode and scan the barcode. It should pick up all the settings (double check your alarms). Then disable the original master being sync master.
